predictions.selection_reason: user-controlled data-youtube attribute -> img.src assignment -> potential resource loading from malicious domain
predictions.source_summary: id parameter comes from elem.getAttribute('data-youtube') via event listener on 'lazybeforeunveil' event
predictions.sink_summary: img.src assignment loads image from YouTube's img.youtube.com domain
predictions.guard_summary: No validation on id value before URL construction; only checks that youtube attribute exists and elem is not null
predictions.risk_pattern: User-controlled data-youtube attribute value directly interpolated into YouTube image URL without validation, allowing potential manipulation of image source
enclosing_conditions: if(youtube && elem) in lazybeforeunveil event handler
predictions.context_summary: The function creates an img element and sets its src to a YouTube thumbnail URL by replacing {{id}} placeholder with the data-youtube attribute value
unresolved_facts: Whether data-youtube values are validated/sanitized before being set in HTML
Whether YouTube's img.youtube.com service validates video IDs before serving images

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')
top_sast_rules.description: Server-side URL redirection based on unvalidated user input may cause redirection to malicious web sites.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Validate redirect URLs against allowlists. Use relative URLs where possible and avoid user-controlled redirects.
